title: Quantization profile sentinel: adaptive calibration and similarity-regression validation for embeddings
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Build an operational 'sentinel' for embedding quantization profiles (INT8 and FP16) that combines an adaptive calibration pipeline with an automated similarity-regression validation harness. The intent is to detect real-world semantic degradation early and provide safe rollout/rollback rules for serving variants.

Context: We already have per-model quant profiles but lack a lightweight, repeatable pipeline that: 1) produces per-corpus/profile scale factors and bias adjustments; 2) evaluates embedding fidelity using realistic downstream tasks; and 3) integrates into CI/CD and runtime monitoring to catch regressions after rollout. Prior work focused on offline calibration sweeps; this ticket operationalizes that into a sentinel with alerts and automated recalibration triggers.

Scope: Implement the calibration job, validation suite, CI integration, dashboard metrics, and rollout policies. Do not change runtime kernels here — this is profile/ops work and detection only.

Deliverables:
- calibration job that outputs INT8 and FP16 profile artifacts with deterministic seed and metadata (model version, seed, corpus id).
- validation harness that runs three canonical tasks (semantic search MRR, kNN retrieval precision@10, and classification embedding-proxy ROC AUC) and computes similarity-preservation metrics (median cosine retention, tail 1%-ile shift, pairwise distance KL).
- sentinel dashboard with baseline vs current deltas and alerting rules (SLO breach + delta thresholds).
- rollout policy docs: canary thresholds and automatic rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration job produces artifacts for INT8 and FP16 with reproducible metadata and stored in s3://redwood-quant/profiles/{model}/{date}/{corpus}/
Validation harness runs in CI within 30 minutes for sample corpora and produces a summary JSON with metrics: median_cosine_retention, tail_shift_1pct, kl_distance_histogram
Sentinel dashboard panel displays baseline vs current for at least three metrics and raises an alert when median_cosine_retention < 0.92 OR tail_shift_1pct > 0.05 OR KL divergence > 0.02
Canary rollout script rejects deployment (rolls back) if validation metrics cross alert thresholds during a 1-hour canary window
Automated periodic recalibration job can be scheduled (cron) and pushes results to the dashboard and CI artifacts bucket
tasks: Design adaptive calibration algorithm: per-corpus scale table + layerwise clipping heuristics
Implement calibration job with streaming histogram collection (sampled activations) and deterministic quantization mapping
Create validation harness that accepts a profile artifact and returns the metrics JSON
Wire validation into CI pipeline (pr and nightly flows) and attach artifact links to PRs
Build dashboard panels and alerting rules in Grafana/Prometheus (or Datadog) and document playbook
Write rollout and rollback scripts that query validation output and enforce thresholds during canary
test_plan: Unit tests for calibration statistics (moments, histograms and percentile calculations)
Synthetic regression tests: inject controlled noise into embeddings and verify detection sensitivity (e.g., scale perturbation 2% should be detected)
Integration test: run full pipeline on small holdout corpora (semantic-search-sample, qna-sample, support-tickets-sample) and assert metrics above thresholds
End-to-end canary test: deploy to canary pool and run validation harness automatically, simulate rollback condition and confirm action
monitoring: alert: quant-sentinel-degradation -> triggers on any rule in acceptance_criteria; pages on P1
log: calibration-run-{id}.json stored with profile artifact for forensic analysis
risks: False positives on small corpora — mitigated by requiring multiple metric breaches or minimum sample size (N>=10k embeddings)
Run time and CI flakiness if histograms are sampled inconsistently — enforce deterministic seeding and sampling policy
Operational burden from frequent recalibrations — add hysteresis and backoff policy
Edge cases for multilingual corpora where cosine baselines differ — include corpus-type metadata and separate baselines
